title: AnswerResult
description: The result of an AnswerRequest (master plan 14.2, 12.5), discriminated by outcome: answered is a GroundedAnswer with a citation for every claim, no_supported_evidence is a NoSupportedEvidence result. There is no third shape: no uncited answer, no empty answer, no error string standing in for either. A request that could not be run at all (scope missing, source store unavailable, timeout) is a typed error, not a member of this union.
